reviews.comment: I had her my first semester freshman year and was my first lecture ever. She was the sweetest professor and I would take her all my semesters if I could! She cares about your ability to understand the content and how you can apply rather than grades. She is flexible and straight to the point. She knows what she talks about and does so passionately!

She was understanding and passionate about what she was teaching and it showed! I hate getting up early, but having this class as my 8 am made it a lot easier. Definitely going to have to pay attention but its easier to listen to someone who likes what they are talking about. I had really bad strep and flu for two weeks and she helped me catch up!

reviews.comment: Megan was an amazing instructor, and really made the class a blast for us. Her genealogy project was a really great opportunity to dig into my family history, and frankly, all the activities she designed were informative and interesting.

Megan was a great instructor for Historical Arch! She delved into topics not commonly covered in other ANTH classes and made lectures interesting and engaging. The quizzes were straight to the point and easy if you attended class and studied your lectures. She responded quickly to emails and was always available for help outside of class.
